blocked_note: Chris's rule (2026-10-26): no sources with a hard ad-block wall or a paywall (hard or metered). Soft, dismissible ad-block popups are fine. build_news.py drops any feed or item whose host matches blocked_domains, and also drops individual articles whose JSON-LD says isAccessibleForFree:false or that carry the PMC/Admiral 'To access our site, disable your adblocker' wall.
